race.description: Buy Your Kosciuszko Tickets At Tab Highway Hcp (C3)
race.comment: Another competitive Highway with the main chances drawing out. MRS GOLDBERG (4) carved out slick figures first up to score a dominant win over 1100m at this track from an awkward gate. Rawiller sticks and she can progress quickly this time in. WAYBURN (2) another from the Dunn stable who demolished inferior opposition over 1200m at Rosehill in this grade. Will appreciate the fast tempo from the wide gate with Newman's 3kg claim. Expected to go close. LADY OLENNA (7) big drifter in betting on resumption before closing strongly to finish fourth over 1000m here. Extra trip in her favour with J Mac retaining the ride. DUBBO BOY (18) comes here in peak condition and stays in the mix from the low draw. The race doesn't end there.
